label: EXACT_EXECUTABLE_ORIGINAL
minimum_evidence: All features, weights, normalization, aggregation, orientation and cutpoint match; numerical equivalence checked when reference output exists

label: PRESPECIFIED_PLATFORM_BRIDGED_EXACT_FUNCTION
minimum_evidence: Outcome-blind complete platform mapping preserves function and patient ranking/classification
interpretation_boundary: Report bridge explicitly; not the literal original platform

label: SOURCE_COMPATIBLE_APPROXIMATION
minimum_evidence: Auditable source-compatible rule with every divergence and missing component documented
interpretation_boundary: Cannot be interpreted as an exact test of the original assay

label: PARTIAL_OR_MISSING_COMPONENT
minimum_evidence: Some biomarker information exists but claim-defining components remain missing

label: NONEXECUTABLE
minimum_evidence: No lawful auditable implementation can be produced
